title: packages: a package export marks each withheld connector header/env map, so an import knows it is incomplete (#28640 ruling 3A)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

carries item ③A (the export marker) of #28640; #28640 keeps items ①A (filed beside this card) and ②B (the spec slice).

Ruling-ref: 6566912252 (director record, batch #451 item 1, letters ①A·②B·③A, the maintainer's 「同意」). Filing gate: executing a recorded ruling. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it; the ruling's Execution line names `domain:server` for this slice.

## What the ruling binds (③A, quoted from 6566912252)

"**③A — maps stay withheld whole.** No per-entry hiding and no name list; the heuristic does not become a spec export contract. The package export marks each withheld map position so an import elsewhere knows the map is incomplete (the follow-up the #28596 review's ③(4) owes). Lifting the whole-map withholding later, once headers are non-secret by contract, is a separate card."

## Where (seat readings on `origin/main` at filing)

- The connector redactor withholds `providerConfig.headers`, `defaultHeaders`, `transport.headers` and `transport.env` whole (`connector-credential-redaction.test.ts` pins it); the #28596 contract review 6555639907 ③(4) names the consequence: a package exported and re-imported elsewhere loses those maps, as it loses a webhook's `headers` today (#24994 ruling B+).

## Wanted

- The package export marks each withheld map position, so an import elsewhere can tell the map is incomplete rather than empty. The marker's spelling is the implementer's to measure against the existing export shape; if it needs a new spec key, that half goes to `domain:spec` first.
- Tests: an export of a package whose connector carries those maps names each withheld position; one without them carries no marker.

Workload (ruling): one small `domain:server` PR, no same-shape precedent.
